description: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka Limited v. A.S. Mohammed Hassan Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka Limited v. A.S. Mohammed Hassan View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka Limited v. A.S. Mohammed Hassan Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka Limited v. A.S. Mohammed Hassan View More
keywords: Breach of contract for sale of portable rectified spirits; whether time of delivery was of the essence; plaintiff failed to deliver balance quantity per delivery schedule despite extensions of letter of credit; goods found to vary from sample and defective in quality/packing; trial judge\'s findings on delivery schedule and sample-quality issues held misdirected. Held - Appeal allowed in part, District Court judgment set aside.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
